changeSet.author: bbcms
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO bbcms_role_permission (role_id, permission_code) SELECT r.id, p.code FROM bbcms_role r CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('bbcms:publication:read'), ('bbcms:intercession:read'), ('bbcms:event:read'), ('bbcms:evangelism:read'), ('bbcms:discipleship:read'), ('bbcms:financial:contribution-read') ) AS p(code) WHERE r.id IN ( '11111111-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', -- NATIONAL_LEADER '11111111-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', -- BBC_LEADER '11111111-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', -- CLASS_LEADER '11111111-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', -- MENTOR '11111111-0000-0000-0000-000000000006', -- INTERCESSION_LEADER '11111111-0000-0000-0000-000000000007', -- EVANGELISM_LEADER '11111111-0000-0000-0000-000000000008', -- DISCIPLE_MAKER '11111111-0000-0000-0000-000000000009', -- FINANCIAL_LEADER '11111111-0000-0000-0000-00000000000A', -- DAILY_VERSE_LEADER '11111111-0000-0000-0000-00000000000B', -- STUDENT '11111111-0000-0000-0000-00000000000C' -- PROFESSIONAL ) ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_code) DO NOTHING;
